source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: In 9 NF1 patients receiving selumetinib for plexiform neurofibroma, DEXA imaging showed no difference in bone mineral density after 1 year of treatment.
notes: Full text (PMC9629420, HTML). Statement made by the de Blank 2022 review citing Ma 2020 (PMID 32601387, ref 83). Secondary citation: the claim is not independent of the cited primary study; read the primary paper for strength grading. n=9.
